Gmreadaloud: Welcome to Peril to Profit: The Goldspire Messengers. Tonight is a one-shot about a paid delivery job that gets stranger, more dangerous, and more human as you go. You do not need to know Daggerheart before we begin. I will introduce rules only when they matter. Before we start, can everyone see the screen clearly, and does anyone need me to slow down, repeat anything, or adjust where they are sitting?

Takeawayhelp: Players know Kyle's welcome and table frame Players know the tone, GM style, and learn-by-playing promise. You do not need to know Daggerheart tonight; I will teach the rules when they matter." If a player asks what they should focus on: "Focus on what your character wants, what they try, and what they ask. I will handle when dice enter the scene."
